approach: Comparison pages are entirely auto-generated from both constituent products' own data/software/{slug}.json (features, pricing, cons-diff) via lib/comparison.ts -- there is no per-pair content override hook in the current architecture (confirmed by reading app/compare/[comparison]/page.tsx and lib/comparison.ts in full this session). The real lever for comparison-page quality is therefore the underlying product data, not comparison-specific prose.
candidateSelection: 651 comparison URLs were live-GSC-confirmed in the DISCOVERED_NOT_INDEXED bucket and 601 in the true CRAWLED_NOT_INDEXED bucket (see fresh-gsc-baseline.json). Cross-referencing the true-crawled-not-indexed sample against committed GSC impressions and the full frozen/protected-slug registry (all three software waves plus all legacy experiment slugs, checked per-constituent-slug to close the known 'reservedProtection() does not emit /compare/* entries' gap) produced 148 safe candidates, 37 of which have real observed GSC demand (impressions > 0).

treatmentExecuted.mechanism: Software-level factual-depth enrichment (real pricing + 3 real cons) for the 15 unique C/D-grade products dragging down the highest-demand safe comparison candidates.

treatmentDeliberatelyNotExecuted.whyNotTreated: These pairs have both constituent products already at A-grade factual depth, so the software-enrichment lever doesn't apply. The obvious alternative mechanism -- pair-aware 'who should choose' prose, which already exists in this codebase as an EXPERIMENT (data/experiments/comparison-quality-cohort.ts, generateWhoShouldChoosePairAware) -- was checked for real evidence FIRST, per Part 1's own instruction not to redo prior waves' work blindly. That check (see indexation-deltas.json) found the mechanism has produced ZERO of 20 treatment pages transitioning to indexed after 35 days, versus 2 of 20 for the untouched control. Per the master mission's own Part 5 instruction ('if a hypothesis is disproven, STOP optimizing that dimension'), this session does not extend that mechanism to these additional candidates, and does not invent a second, unproven content-prose mechanism to apply to them instead. They remain untreated, documented here as evidence-backed backlog pending a different, better-supported lever (see click-depth.json and indexed-vs-nonindexed.json for what was ruled out) or a future re-check of the existing experiment with more elapsed time.
